name: Yaletown-Roundhouse Station

references.note: Official construction photos: two reversing entrance stair flights perpendicular to the platform.
Tafyrn & Seamora opening photographs; IMG_1084 records the installed Lower Concourse Level fire-evacuation plan: separate street/concourse and concourse/platform lift cores.
Photographed existing-condition evacuation plan, not a proposed station design. Constrains circulation topology and compass orientation; dimensions are inferred.
June 2026: five fare gates, including two accessible gates.
2019 official report confirms both platform-to-concourse escalators operate up.
First-hand 2024 audit: 57 street-to-concourse and41 concourse-to-platform stairs; elevations inferred from normal riser proportions.
Mapped reversing entry passage constrains axis; street doors independently mapped, platform polygon explicitly approximate.
Concrete exterior footway leaves mapped lift door 9133604358 towards the southeast; the passenger enters the street lift towards the northwest, not out into the pavement.
Pre-opening exterior photographs IMG_3630/3632 show the separate glazed lift tower at the pavilion corner, beside the main stair entrance.

authoredInterior.accuracy: Reference-backed passenger topology and visible architecture; dimensions and placement are not a survey.

boardingWaitingOrigins.reason: Capsule-clear track-edge aisles beside the standalone platform stair shaft; contained inside the retained waiting regions.
boardingWaitingOrigins.unchanged: Train poses, carriage-local doors, station sills, platform edges, rail heights and threshold bridges.

platformStairDivider.status: Photographed central stainless divider is physical. Rail/post dimensions and the side walking line are representative, not surveyed. Signs occupy flat end bays outside both lower access wells and lift core.

authoredInterior.publicPlatformTopology: one island, with perpendicular upper switchback and separate street/concourse and concourse/platform lift shafts

verticalInference.status: First-hand stair counts constrain representative proportions; not surveyed slab elevations

horizontalInference.status: Existing photographed evacuation plan and OSM passage constrain topology and axes; metre dimensions remain representative
horizontalInference.caution: 2009 photographed Lower Concourse Level plan is an existing-condition reference, not a measured CAD drawing. Active platform centre derives from OSM approximate polygon.

streetLiftApproach.status: Mapped doorway/approach fixes the entrance side. Cabin size, tower height and inset pavilion portal remain representative, not surveyed.

unverifiedDetails: The 28/29 division of the observed57 upper steps is inferred; exact widths and riser heights are not surveyed.
The installed evacuation plan establishes two separate lift cores. Exact shaft dimensions and the intervening passage widths remain representative.
